title: Gauge-invariant Higgs mechanism via gradient-flow regularization
summary: We provide a manifestly gauge-invariant description of the Higgs mechanism in the Standard Model, casting it not as the breaking of a local symmetry, but as a smooth, analytic crossover from a high-temperature symmetric phase to a low-temperature Higgs phase. Taking the vacuum expectation value of a gauge-invariant local scalar operator and constructing composite quasi-particle states from the original fields of the Lagrangian usually introduces contact-term divergences.
